## What's Changed
* Retry the Maven Wrapper download in CI with exponential backoff by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/198
* Update dependency org.sonatype.central:central-publishing-maven-plugin to v0.11.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/199
* Support default values on Start node inputs by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/205
* Update dependency @playwright/test to v1.64.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/202
* Update react monorepo to v19.3.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/204
* Update actions/setup-java digest to b843ebf by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/206
* Update dependency node to v24.22.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/207
* Update dependency org.sonatype.central:central-publishing-maven-plugin to v0.12.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/200
* Host-configurable icon and color for Action nodes by action type by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/215
* Update jackson monorepo to v2.22.4 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/214
* Update dependency eslint to v10.13.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/213
* Update Apitomy/apitomy-github-actions action to v1.0.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/212
* Update dependency @patternfly/react-icons to v6.7.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/211
* Update dependency @patternfly/react-core to v6.7.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/210
* Update dependency @patternfly/patternfly to v6.7.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/209
* Update dependency vitest to v4.1.12 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/208
* Warn about redundant default edges (#203) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/216
* Add WorkflowEditorHandle.select to select and center a node or edge (#201) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/217
* Select applied change set elements instead of highlighting them by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/218


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/compare/v3.0.2...v3.0.3
